question_record.context: A security incident reported suspicious sequence of exploration activities where a process called a set of Windows commands. These commands can be used by attackers to identify assets of value and coordinate lateral movement after compromising a machine. Several instances of `net.exe` and `whoami.exe` commands were executed within a short period of time.
question_record.question: As part of the same security incident, a known credential theft tool was executed. Can you identify the name of the tool used for credential theft?
solution: A process `powershell.exe` conducted a sequence of suspicious exploration activities on 2024-07-04 22:35:02.508708+00:00.
A malicious credential theft tool `mimikatz.exe` was executed on 2024-07-04 22:35:00.823035+00:00.

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention' AND o.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s,%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
